title: CLEVER: A Curated Benchmark for Formally Verified Code Generation
authors_zh: Amitayush Thakur, Jasper Lee, George Tsoukalas, Meghana Sistla, Matthew Zhao, Stefan Zetzsche, Greg Durrett, Yisong Yue, Swarat Chaudhuri
paper_type_zh: 手工审校的 Lean 形式验证代码生成基准
best_for_zh: 需要联合评测规格生成与可证明 Lean 实现生成的研究者。
one_line: CLEVER evaluates end-to-end Lean verified code generation on 161 hand-curated tasks with held-out specifications and post-hoc type checking.
CLEVER 包含 161 个手工审校任务，要求生成与保留规格一致的 Lean 实现，并由类型检查器在事后验证。
why: It avoids test-only shortcuts and checks a complete specification-to-implementation contract in Lean.
inclusion_reason: CLEVER supplies hand-curated Lean specifications and proof-checked implementations for verified code generation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Ordinary code generation uses finite tests that can be overfit through examples, hard-coded outputs, or specification ambiguity. Some formally verified code datasets provide specifications that leak implementation logic or rely on LLM-generated annotations and goals permitting vacuous proofs. A passing proof then does not show that a model correctly derived a specification from natural language and implemented it. The absence of a high-quality benchmark limits comparison of end-to-end verified code generation.

CLEVER manually curates 161 Lean problems with two stages: generate a formal specification equivalent to a held-out ground-truth specification from signatures, docstrings, and test information, then generate a Lean implementation provably satisfying that specification. Outputs are verified post hoc by Lean’s type checker rather than tests or an LLM judge.

普通代码生成依靠有限测试判断正确性，模型可通过过拟合样例、硬编码或规格歧义获得高分。已有形式验证代码集有时直接提供泄露实现逻辑的 specification，或使用 LLM 生成标注和容易出现空洞证明的目标，使“证明通过”并不代表模型从自然语言正确推导规格并实现程序。缺少高质量 benchmark 阻碍端到端 verified code generation 的比较。

CLEVER 手工整理 161 个 Lean 问题，每题分两阶段：先根据函数签名、docstring 和测试信息生成与隐藏 ground-truth 等价的形式规格，再生成能够被证明满足该规格的 Lean 实现。最终输出由 Lean type checker 后验验证，而不是由测试通过或 LLM judge 判定。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is a rigorous benchmark that combines specification generation with verified implementation generation. Its 161 records include function signatures, docstrings, tests, natural-language specifications, held-out formal ground truth, generated specifications, isomorphism theorems and proofs, implementations, correctness theorems, and helper lemmas. Specifications do not directly reveal implementation logic and annotations are not LLM-generated. A generated specification must be related to hidden ground truth through an equivalence or isomorphism proof, while code must satisfy a correctness theorem. Lean type checking verifies all objects, testing formal semantics rather than behavior on finite inputs.

核心贡献是把 specification generation 与 verified implementation generation 组合为一个严格 benchmark。161 条记录包含函数签名、docstring、测试、自然语言规格、隐藏形式真值、生成规格、同构定理及证明、实现、正确性定理和辅助 lemma。数据避免把实现逻辑直接写入规格，也不使用 LLM 自动标注；规格需通过与隐藏真值之间的等价/同构证明，代码则需通过 correctness theorem。所有对象由 Lean 类型检查器验证，因此验证的是形式语义，不是有限输入上的行为相似。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Curate tasks manually: Program problems expressible in Lean are selected with function signatures, docstrings, example tests, and natural-language requirements that do not reveal implementations.
  1. Create hidden specifications: Experts author ground-truth formal specifications and check that they exclude constant answers, inconsistent assumptions, and other vacuous solutions.
  1. Evaluate specification generation: Models output Lean specifications. The system requires an isomorphism or equivalence theorem to the hidden specification, and only Lean-accepted outputs proceed.
  1. Evaluate program generation: Models generate Lean implementations, correctness proofs, and helper lemmas. End-to-end success requires every artifact to type-check.

1. 人工策划任务： 选择可在 Lean 中表达的程序问题，编写函数签名、docstring、示例测试和不泄露实现的自然语言需求。
  1. 建立隐藏规格： 专家给出 ground-truth formal specification，并检查它排除常量答案、矛盾前提和其他 vacuous solution。
  1. 评测规格生成： 模型输出 Lean specification；系统要求生成或检查其与隐藏规格之间的同构/等价 theorem，Lean 通过才进入下一阶段。
  1. 评测程序生成： 模型生成 Lean implementation、correctness proof 和必要 lemma；只有全部类型检查通过才算端到端成功。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors evaluate multiple few-shot and agentic state-of-the-art methods on 161 problems, and all struggle on the terminal criterion requiring both a correct specification and a fully verified implementation, showing that ordinary code-generation ability does not saturate the benchmark. Every success requires both a proof of equivalence to the hidden specification and an implementation correctness proof accepted by Lean, preventing credit from incomplete finite tests. Detailed fields and evaluation code are public for replay. This supports rigor, but the dataset is small and Lean expressiveness and proof-search cost are entangled with programming ability.

作者在多种 few-shot 与 agentic SOTA 模型上评测 161 题，所有方法在“规格正确且实现被完整证明”这一终局指标上都表现困难，说明任务未被普通代码生成能力饱和。每个成功案例需要隐藏规格等价证明和 implementation correctness proof 均由 Lean 接受，因此不会因有限测试覆盖不足获得分数。数据还公开详细字段和评测代码，便于逐项重放。该证据支持 benchmark 的严格性，但规模较小，且 Lean 表达能力与证明搜索成本会与程序设计能力共同影响结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html: APPS and HumanEval use tests for implementation checking, while formal datasets such as FVAPPS usually provide specifications and evaluate only implementation or proof completion. CLEVER hides the specification and first requires models to derive it from natural language and prove equivalence to ground truth before implementing code. Manual curation avoids LLM annotations and vacuous specifications. The novelty is not the first use of Lean for code verification but a natural-language–formal-specification–implementation–proof chain in which specification errors cannot be concealed by later hard-coding.

APPS、HumanEval 以测试检查实现，FVAPPS 等形式化数据通常直接提供 specification，只评测填充实现或证明。CLEVER 的变化是把规格本身隐藏起来并要求模型先从自然语言生成，再证明生成规格与 ground truth 等价，之后才实现程序。它还通过人工策划避免 LLM annotation 与 vacuous specification。新意不是首次用 Lean 验证代码，而是建立“自然语言—正式规格—实现—证明”的双层验证链，使规格理解错误不能被后续硬编码掩盖。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Small scale: The 161 high-quality tasks support precise evaluation but do not cover complex state, concurrency, performance properties, or broad data structures and are unsuitable as a primary large-scale SFT corpus.
  1. Proof–programming entanglement: Failures may arise from Lean tactic search rather than specification or algorithm errors. Equivalence, implementation existence, and proof completion should be reported separately.
  1. Manual-selection bias: Curation to avoid vacuous specifications may favor problems easy to express in Lean. Expansion should document exclusion reasons and domain distributions.

1. 规模较小： 161 个高质量任务适合精确评测，但不足以覆盖复杂数据结构、状态、并发或性能性质，也不宜直接作为大规模 SFT 主语料。
  1. 证明与编程耦合： 失败可能来自 Lean tactic 搜索，而非规格或算法错误。应分别报告规格等价、实现存在和 proof completion 三类成功率。
  1. 人工选择偏差： 为避免空洞规格而进行的策划可能偏向易于在 Lean 表达的问题。扩展时需记录排除原因和领域分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. End-to-end vericoding evaluation: Measure specification-equivalence rate, verified-implementation rate, and complete success separately with fixed Lean versions and proof budgets.
  1. Staged training: First fine-tune NL-to-spec models, then use specification equivalence and correctness theorems as verifiers for RL. Hidden ground truth must not be exposed to policy inputs.
  1. Data expansion: Reuse manual specification audits, vacuity checks, and the dual-proof contract. Tasks whose properties cannot be precisely expressed in Lean, or that require only runtime correctness, should use test-based benchmarks instead.

1. 端到端 vericoding 评测： 分别测规格等价率、实现证明率和完整成功率，固定 Lean 版本与 proof budget。
  1. 分阶段训练： 先在 NL→spec 上 SFT，再用 spec equivalence 和 correctness theorem 作为 verifier 做 RL；不能把隐藏 ground truth 暴露给策略输入。
  1. 数据扩展： 复用人工规格审计、vacuity 检查和双证明合同构建新任务。若目标性质不能在 Lean 中精确表达，或只需要普通运行正确性，应选择测试型 benchmark 而非强行形式化。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: CLEVER requires models to generate a correct formal specification and then a Lean implementation proved to satisfy it.
  2. Method takeaway: Hidden specifications, equivalence proofs, implementation correctness theorems, and vacuity audits are central.
  3. Data takeaway: It contains 161 manually curated tasks with signatures, docstrings, specifications, isomorphism proofs, implementations, and helper lemmas.
  4. Evidence anchor: All state-of-the-art approaches struggle with full verification, and successes receive dual confirmation from Lean’s type checker.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits strict vericoding, but failure sources must be separated and proof-search failure must not be equated with algorithmic error.

1. 一句话定位： CLEVER 要求模型先生成正确形式规格，再生成被 Lean 证明满足该规格的实现。
  2. 方法抓手： 隐藏规格、等价证明、实现 correctness theorem 和 vacuity 审计是核心。
  3. 数据抓手： 161 个手工任务，字段覆盖签名、docstring、规格、同构证明、实现和辅助 lemma。
  4. 证据锚点： 所有 SOTA 方法在完整验证上仍困难，成功由 Lean type checker 双层确认。
  5. 复用决定： 适合严格 vericoding；必须分解失败来源，不能把 proof search 失败等同算法错误。
